notes_for_editor: Story is below the 120-word floor because the only sources are an OpenStreetMap entry and the town entry; no lookout history was found in two searches. A search surfaced a different Clark County tower near Alpine (1993 visitor account, staffing by Mattie Robertson); it is not linked to Okolona and is not used. Wikipedia's infobox coordinate (34 59 58 N) disagrees with the OSM point (34.022 N); not used. The brief has county null; the Encyclopedia of Arkansas supports Clark County, so the county could be filled, but that is not a correction.
